R1.description: The Claude and Codex harnesses are reached through one adapter registry that declares their names, family, roles, restriction ability, usage reporting and pinned version, refuses a role an adapter lacks with a typed error, derives the family and harness-name tables and pins the other declarations by test, all keeping their values (D3, D4)

R2.description: The git host is reached through a registry of adapters with declared capabilities whose closed set equals the repository policy's `FORGE_KINDS`, and an unregistered kind refuses with a typed error (D5)

R3.description: One usage record, with per-group quality flags, cost with its source and a versioned price table, is built by one converter per harness from a captured sample, and invents no figure (D6, D7, D8)

R4.description: The record is written where the figures exist (worker completion paths; every review job end in which an attempt ran), cannot change a job's outcome, and leaves every printed line and every existing test unchanged, adding only the one key to `resume --json` (D1, D6, D9, D9a)

R5.description: The guides and the roadmap agree with the behaviour; `check_docs`, the golden `--check` forms and the full suite are green (D10)
